data.name: Ruqayya
data.gender_notes: Ruqayya is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ر-ق-ي (r-q-y), 'to rise, ascend'. Ruqayya means 'ascent, elevation'. Its root is ر-ق-ي (r-q-y). Borne by Ruqayya, daughter of the Prophet ﷺ. Ruqayya is a Arabic name meaning “Ascent; rise; elevation”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ruqayya expresses “Ascent; rise; elevation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ر-ق-ي (r-q-y), 'to rise, ascend'. Ruqayya means 'ascent, elevation'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruqayya total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
